categories.main_business_segments: Shenzhen Chipscreen Biosciences Co., Ltd. is a pioneering Chinese innovative drug company focused on original small molecule drug research and development. Its primary business segments include the development, production, and commercialization of innovative drugs targeting malignant tumors, metabolic diseases, autoimmune diseases, central nervous system diseases, and antiviral therapies. The company has established a complete industrial chain from early exploratory discovery to commercialization, with key marketed products including Chidamide (Epidaza®) and Chiglitazar (Bilessglu®).
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages an integrated AI-assisted drug discovery platform based on chemical genomics, combining AI models, physical modeling, and high-performance computing to enhance early-stage drug discovery and evaluation. It employs advanced small molecule drug design, including selective epigenetic modulators and multi-target kinase inhibitors. Production adheres strictly to GMP standards with manufacturing bases in Shenzhen and Chengdu, utilizing planned and order-controlled production modes to ensure quality and supply stability.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company primarily serves hospitals, pharmacies, and healthcare institutions across China, focusing on patients with malignant tumors, metabolic diseases such as type 2 diabetes and metabolic-associated fatty liver disease, and autoimmune conditions. Its products are included in national and provincial medical insurance catalogs, enhancing accessibility. Key customers include major pharmaceutical distributors and hospital networks, with significant sales concentrated in South China, East China, and North China regions.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are primarily based in China with manufacturing facilities in Shenzhen, Chengdu, and a new manufacturing base under construction in Pengzhou. The company also has a subsidiary in the United States for clinical development and international cooperation. Its products are marketed in mainland China, Taiwan, Japan, and are undergoing clinical trials and regulatory processes in multiple countries, reflecting a global development strategy.
categories.supply_chain_position: Chipscreen operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the pharmaceutical supply chain, encompassing drug discovery, clinical development, manufacturing of active pharmaceutical ingredients and finished dosage forms, and commercialization including marketing and sales. It controls the entire value chain from R&D to production and distribution, ensuring quality control and supply chain stability.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in original small molecule drugs with a focus on unmet clinical needs in oncology, metabolic diseases, autoimmune disorders, CNS diseases, and antiviral therapies. It integrates AI and chemical genomics for drug discovery, accelerates clinical development with global registration strategies, and expands indications for existing drugs. Strategic R&D projects include advancing late-stage clinical trials for Chidamide, Chiglitazar, and novel candidates like CS231295 and CS23546, with emphasis on global competitiveness and differentiated mechanisms.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of innovative drugs, including Chidamide and Chiglitazar, to hospitals and pharmacies via a combination of direct sales and distributor networks. Additional revenue streams include technology licensing fees and clinical collaboration income. The company also benefits from government subsidies and participates in national medical insurance reimbursement programs, enhancing product accessibility and sales volume.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Chipscreen is positioned as a leading original innovative drug developer in China, recognized for pioneering first-in-class and best-in-class small molecule drugs. It competes with domestic and international pharmaceutical companies in oncology and metabolic disease markets. The company maintains a competitive edge through proprietary technology platforms, robust patent portfolios, and a growing global clinical pipeline. Its products hold unique market positions, such as Chidamide being the only oral innovative drug for certain lymphoma indications in China’s national insurance catalog.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported total operating revenue of approximately RMB 658 million, representing a 25.63% year-over-year increase driven by strong sales growth of Chidamide and Chiglitazar. Despite a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 114.57 million, the company improved cash flow from operations significantly. R&D investment accounted for over 51% of revenue, underscoring its commitment to innovation. Total assets stood at RMB 3.25 billion with a slight increase from the previous year, reflecting steady growth and expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Chipscreen emphasizes its unique value proposition of delivering clinically differentiated, original small molecule drugs with revolutionary mechanisms of action. Its flagship products offer targeted therapies with demonstrated efficacy and safety in difficult-to-treat cancers and metabolic diseases. The integration of AI and chemical genomics enhances drug discovery efficiency and risk mitigation. The company’s strong patent protection, inclusion in national insurance catalogs, and comprehensive clinical evidence provide competitive differentiation and support its goal to become a global leader in innovative pharmaceuticals.
